title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Quick Reference: Replacements, Cancellations, Refunds and Closure
content:
## Quick reference card

Figures used by member services for the Home Delivery Pharmacy when a shipment goes missing, an order is cancelled, a credit balance arises or an account is closed.

| | Voluntary | Standard | Maintenance 90 | Advantage | Maintenance Choice | Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days after the expected delivery date to report a lost or damaged shipment for a free replacement | 10 | 10 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 21 |
| Free replacements for lost or damaged packages per account per plan year | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Dispensed medication returned for credit | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Order dispensed in error credited in full and re-dispensed at no charge | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Last order stage at which the member may cancel | Before dispensing | Before dispensing | Before dispensing | Before dispensing | Before dispensing | Before dispensing |
| Credit balance above which the credit is refunded to the payment method on file (USD) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 5.00 |
| Calendar days after a credit balance arises within which it is refunded | 30 | 30 | 30 | 21 | 21 | 14 |
| Balance due at or below which the remainder is written off when the account closes (USD) | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 5.00 |
| Calendar days the member has to confirm a closure request before it lapses | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Pharmacist reachable by phone around the clock | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### Notes

1. Pharmacy errors never count against the free-replacement allowance.
2. Medication cannot be returned for credit under pharmacy law; only pharmacy errors are credited.

### Reading the card (hypothetical cases)

- A credit balance of 12.00 on a Northbridge Maintenance Choice account is above the 10.00 figure; the same 12.00 on a Northbridge Home Delivery Standard account is not above 25.00.
- A balance due of 1.50 at closure is above the 1.00 write-off figure of Voluntary, Standard and Maintenance 90, and at or below the 2.00 figure of Advantage and Maintenance Choice and the 5.00 figure of Premier.
